name: music_duration
description: Listening test: note duration and tempo accuracy at different CPS values
script: announce 1/8: cps=0.25 — very slow (1 cycle = 4 seconds)
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=0.25
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=0.5
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=1
announce 4/8: cps=2.0 — very fast (1 cycle = 0.5 seconds)
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=2
# === Note length should match slot size (no stacking) ===
announce 5/8: Sustained notes — should NOT stack/overlap
strudel c3 e3 g3 c4 s=pad cps=0.3
announce 6/8: Fast notes — should be crisp, no blur
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*4 s=marimba cps=1
announce 7/8: Sub-cycle — bracketed notes should be half length
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the durations/tempo sound?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
